expected_findings.note: A provider credential literal committed to source is CWE-798 regardless of which detector has a pattern for the format. The value is made up and authorises nothing. MAINTAINER NOTE: the fixture source must never call the value fake/mock/sample/synthetic/placeholder -- analysis.ufib_contracts._SECRET_PLACEHOLDER reads any of those words in the file as decisive counterevidence and the secret contract then abstains, which would make this label fail for a reason that has nothing to do with detection.

notes: Hardcoded AI provider key inside an otherwise normal service file, so this also checks that the SAST family picks up credential literals and not only the secrets family.
